doc: blender/README.md + docs/phase6/review/gates/README.md. Keys: gate_<obby|ring|arena|dungeon|home|altar> (type prop 'gate', kit/props/gates.py; P4 hoop family, contract 6.0.3). One key per gate kind, shared by every BuildGate call of that glyph (lobby, arena Ring / Arena / Return, dungeon portal): gate_home dresses the arena's green Return gate. Pivot = the gate site; WorldStyle.BuildGate tags the gate model (ML_Offset (0, -11.5, 0)). The Neon glow ring / swirl / gems stay Parts.

Nimbus Climb Champion Ring gate: the crowned arch (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb Battle Arena gate: hoop + shield and crossed swords (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb Dungeon gate: hoop + skull over crossed bones (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb Home / Return gate: hoop + little house (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb Storm Altar gate: hoop + storm cloud (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
